name: 工地防砸V型ABS安全帽款
description: 高强ABS壳体抗砸透气、四点内衬佩戴舒适、多色支持定制

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white packshot field alternating with cool light-grey studio panels #E6E8EB and a clean concrete jobsite horizon
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-cool studio light, front-left key with fill card, soft contact shadow grounding the shell, consistent direction across the set
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey studio surface, glossy molded ABS shell, real concrete rooftop and jobsite steel
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short three-layer in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline <=15 chars, 2-4 short labels, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent thin-line circular icons, one cyan accent #17A2B8, long-soft shadow, same stroke weight
styleLock.presentationRules: keep the molded dome, brim and vent row identical across every shot; stable 3/4 hero angle; consistent scale and centering
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium industrial-PPE ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean light-grey studio background #E6E8EB, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, safety-yellow product accent #F2B50C, and one cool cyan secondary accent #17A2B8; neutral-cool studio lighting; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line circular icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 用干净的白底主图在搜索结果里一眼赢得点击。

shots.lighting: bright high-key studio, soft front-left key with fill card, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product}. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Centered front 3/4 view, full product visible, straight-on eye-level and not clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the shell. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. No props. Product occupies 60-70% of frame. 8K commercial e-commerce quality, crisp silhouette and edges. No rendered text. Negative: no props, no hands, no people, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no floating product.

provenance.notes: 9 张详情页切片（源夹标为「五金」）判读真实主体为 V型ABS防砸安全帽：黄色注塑壳体、侧面透气孔、帽檐、四点织物内衬，工地场景。L1/L2 未选「家装灯具/五金工具」——安全帽是头部防护用品而非工具或五金件，故按功能归入 家居日用/防护，与源夹「五金」不符。已剥离：品牌字（如厂牌名）、模特身份、认证与标准编号（GB 类代号）、抗砸力值等测试数字、颜色规格数字、以及联系方式/二维码会员角标；所有数值与文案脱敏为 {selling_point_*}/{callout_*}/{accent_color} 占位符，信任镜留白待真实资质后期合成，未编造任何认证或检测数据。
